comparison.objective: Hand-mount the final section of a bicycle tire bead into the rim by feeding it into the drop centre without levering beneath it; candidate sifts ceramic media while retaining washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive compliant bead deformation, circumferential feeding, opposing-hand tension/control and rim-channel seating versus rigid screen grasping, load sharing, agitation and selective loose-body passage.
comparison.success_condition: PR grades bead seating around the rim/drop-centre geometry with tool-use, damage and release constraints; candidate grades recovered media mass, retention of both washers, absence of spill/joint break, support reseating, hand clearance and continuous 3 s stability.
comparison.reason: The tire task tests compliant closed-loop installation and progressive seating, not selective separation of free rigid bodies through apertures. Their common force control and bimanual coordination are generic primitives, and the supplied spec history is sufficient to distinguish them.
